rationale: The bid-ask spread of 80 bps creates an immediate structural disadvantage that makes any intraday edge difficult to capture profitably. Price is in a sharp downtrend (gapped down 2.44%, now trading near session lows at 21.2% of range, well below VWAP of $20.62 and the 9-EMA at $21.40), but the last candle made a new low at $19.52 with momentum still accelerating downward, making a long entry premature without stabilization. A short entry here risks a violent snap-back given the extended move from prior close, and the wide spread combined with thin liquidity (relative volume elevated but absolute volume modest for a $20 stock) makes precise risk management unreliable.
